outcome: ROTEM EXTEM assay parameters: Clotting time
cohort: The study participants were 198 healthy full-term neonates (>=37 weeks' gestation) and 84 healthy pre-term infants (<37 weeks' gestation) from whom peripheral arterial whole blood samples were collected.
finding: Pre-term neonates exhibited enhanced fibrinolytic activity, characterized by a statistically significantly different lysis index at 60 min (LI60) compared to full-term neonates, with LI60 inversely correlated with gestational age and birth weight in pre-term neonates.
cross-section timing: Measurements were taken shortly after birth from neonates.
birth_weight: Birth weight was measured for the neonates and found to be inversely correlated with LI60 in pre-term neonates.
gest_age: Full-term neonates were ≥37 weeks' gestation, and pre-term neonates were <37 weeks' gestation.
